login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your production desk.
login.invalidCredentials: That e-mail or password is not right
login.emailNotVerified: Verify your e-mail address before signing in.

mfa.title: Enter your authentication code
mfa.hint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.recoveryHint: Use one of the 10 codes you saved. Signing in with a recovery code signs out every other device.
mfa.challengeExpired: The authentication challenge expired. Enter your password to start again.

enrol.title: Turn on two-step verification
enrol.intro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code to add Night Tales Studio to your authenticator app
enrol.qrFailed: The QR code could not be created. The manual key below still works.
enrol.recoverySaveAll: Print or save all 10 codes before continuing.
enrol.doneBody: From your next sign-in, also enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
enrol.enrolmentBannerTitle: A required step before using Night Tales Studio
enrol.enrolmentBannerBody: This enrolment session opens only this page and expires after 15 minutes.
enrol.reauthBody: A full session must be confirmed before loading a key.
enrol.expiredBody: This step stays open for 15 minutes. Sign in again to restart.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.hint: Enter your account e-mail. We will send a reset link.
forgot.sentHint: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.successHint: Every other device was signed out. Sign in again with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link cannot be used
reset.missingTokenHint: The link expired or was already used. Request a new one to continue.
